# LocalEvolutionRules

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Network growth or rewiring rules applied at the node level that determine how topology changes over time. Governs how iNEST architectures self-organize, impacting computational capacity and path diversity without global control.
